probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) A method for generating a superframe preamble for a superframe, the superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols, in an orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) network, comprising: for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over a portion of the carrier; and for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel.

2. (Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over a portion of the carrier.

3. (Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over a portion of the carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern.

4. (Currently Amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the second set of subcarriers distributed over a portion of the carrier.

19. (Currently Amended) A superframe generator in a base station in an OFDM network, comprising a preamble generator operable to generate a superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols for a superframe by (i) for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over a portion of the carrier, and (ii) for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel.

20. (Currently Amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over a portion of the carrier.

21. (Currently Amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over a portion of the carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern.
